translation:
Then, before and after the Perfected Sun, among people there were Shenshi, Minister Cui, Hermit Sun, Zhang Wenzhong, Meng of Tongzhou, Xu Renze, and Wu Sheng, and among formulas there were the 《Guangji》 (Broad Relief), 《Luyan》 (Recorded Proofs), 《Shanfan》 (Abridgment), 《Zhouhou》 (Prescriptions for Emergencies), 《Yannian》 (Prolonging Life), 《Duanju》 (Short and Complete), and 《Bixiao》 (Certain Effect). They divided into schools and branches, but no one had ever synthesized and compiled them. Only Prefect Wang Tao, having lived in the academy for twenty years, gathered and collected the many books, and assembled them into formulas and strategies, reaching up to Yan and Hao and down to the various schools. The 《Shanghan》 (Cold Damage) followed Zhongjing throughout, and the discourses were mostly headed by the 《Bingyuan》. Although he set aside the needling method and did not speak of it, among the formulas before the great Tang,

the 《Qianjin》 was the most numerous. There were forty volumes in all and more than six thousand formulas, gathering the great completion of medical formulas.
